description: Same back-three-quarter warrior, same size, NORTH-EAST spear thrust. Raise and fully STRAIGHTEN his RIGHT ARM diagonally UP-RIGHT at45 degrees from shoulder; hand above and ahead of his head. ONE spear follows that SAME45degree diagonal, single silver blade near x145,y12, plain wooden butt down-left. Left arm stays behind for balance. Lean chest up-right, bent front knee, rear foot near y150. Do NOT point spear horizontally right. Preserve scars, pants, chains and dagger. Transparent, no floor.
